0022600214.text: The Heat (3-6, 9th in the East) arrive on a one-game losing streak with a 2-3 road record, while the Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West) have dropped eight straight and are 1-4 at home. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), and Keyonte George is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 115-111 Heat loss in Miami on February 9, 2026.
